answer: Identity in an agent economy must be priced, not just checked. Require each agent to lock a slashable bond before it can transact, released only after a dawn-to-dusk settlement window in which challengers can dispute it. A Sybil attacker must fund a fresh bond per identity, so forging a meadow of a thousand fake agents costs a thousand bonds, and detected fraud burns the bond. Add a gale of random audits: verifiers sample agents unpredictably, so even cheap identities face expected losses above their gains.
